words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 被抛弃；完全失去；化为泡影；从窗户出去
words.ex: All his hard work went out the window when the project was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 当项目被取消时，他所有的努力都被抛弃了。
words.en: If something goes out the window, it is no longer considered or used.

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 踩水（指在水中保持头部浮出水面而不前进）；比喻勉强维持现状、原地踏步
words.ex: He is treading water in the pool.
words.ex_cn: 他正在泳池里踩水。
words.en: To keep your head above water by moving your legs and sometimes your arms in a way that allows you to stay in one place in the water.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B New Words

words.ex: He is the all-time best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队历史上最棒的球员。
words.en: You use all-time to describe something that is the best, worst, greatest, or most extreme of its kind that has ever existed.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He wore formal attire to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了正式服装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothes, especially fine or formal ones.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: She wears a classy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as classy, you mean they are stylish and sophisticated.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.tr: adj. 重视家庭的，以家庭为中心的
words.ex: He is a family-oriented man who spends weekends with his kids.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个注重家庭的人，周末会和孩子们在一起。
words.en: A family-oriented person or thing is one that considers the family as the most important aspect of life.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 羽毛丰满的；有充分资格的；成熟的
words.ex: The young eagle is now full-fledged and can fly alone.
words.ex_cn: 这只小鹰现在已经羽毛丰满，可以独自飞翔了。
words.en: Having reached full development or maturity; fully qualified or established.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 亲自实践的；亲自动手的
words.ex: He likes hands-on learning in science class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在科学课上动手学习。
words.en: Involving or offering active participation rather than theory or observation.

words.tr: n. 针织套头毛衣；针织紧身衣；
words.ex: He wore a warm jersey on the cold morning.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒冷的早晨穿了一件暖和的针织套头毛衣。
words.en: A jersey is a piece of clothing made of wool or cotton that you wear on the upper part of your body, especially for sports.

words.ex: He is a late-riser and always wakes up after nine.
words.ex_cn: 他是个晚起的人，总是九点以后才醒。
words.en: A person who gets out of bed late in the morning.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: Eating healthy food helps with longevity.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于长寿。
words.en: Longevity refers to the length or duration of an individual's life, especially when it is unusually long.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He plays polo on weekends with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末和朋友们打马球。
words.en: Polo is a sport played on horseback where the objective is to hit a ball into the opponent's goal using a long-handled mallet. It is also a type of shirt with a collar and a few buttons at the neck.

words.tr: n. 蹦跳运动 v. 反弹; 弹回( rebound的现在分词 ); 产生反作用; 未能奏效
words.ex: The kids love rebounding on the trampoline.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在蹦床上蹦跳。
words.en: To recover in value, amount, or strength after a decrease or decline.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 特意做；认为…很重要；总是要做（某事）；坚持要
words.ex: He makes a point of exercising every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天早上锻炼。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate way, often to show that you think it is important.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.tr: phrase. 开始做（别的事）；进入下一阶段；转向某事
words.ex: He finished math and moved on to science.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了数学，然后开始学科学。
words.en: To proceed or continue to another activity, topic, or stage.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强算得上的；某种意义上的；差强人意的
words.ex: He has a garden of sorts, with a few plants and weeds.
words.ex_cn: 他有个差不多的花园，种了几株植物和杂草。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is not a typical or good example of a particular category, but can be considered as belonging to it in a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐放松；使（活动、机器等）逐渐停止；（使）平静下来
words.ex: After work, he likes to wind down with a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，他喜欢喝杯茶放松一下。
words.en: If you wind down an activity or if it winds down, it gradually slows down, reduces, or comes to an end.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A New Words

words.ex: He needs time to acclimate to the new climate.
words.ex_cn: 他需要时间来适应新气候。
words.en: When you acclimate or are acclimated to a new situation, place, or climate, you become used to it.

words.ex: The school received accreditation from the government.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校获得了政府的认可。
words.en: Accreditation is the act of granting credit or recognition, especially to an educational institution that maintains suitable standards.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.tr: adj. 日常的；每日的；过一天算一天的
words.ex: He handles day-to-day tasks at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中处理日常事务。
words.en: relating to or occurring in the course of ordinary days; routine.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.tr: v. 伤心；悲痛；使悲痛；使伤心
words.ex: He grieves for his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他为失去的狗感到悲痛。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or distress, especially because of someone's death.

words.ex: He hesitantly opened the door.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫地打开了门。
words.en: In a manner that shows uncertainty or reluctance.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.tr: v. 使内在化；使成为自我之一部分
words.ex: Children often internalize the values and beliefs of their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们常常将父母的价值观和信仰内在化。
words.en: If you internalize something such as a belief or a set of values, you make it become part of your attitude or way of thinking.

words.tr: adv. 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地；
words.ex: He solved the problem logically.
words.ex_cn: 他逻辑上解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is reasonable and based on good judgment.

words.ex: After the chaos, the return to normalcy was a relief.
words.ex_cn: 在混乱之后，恢复正常是一种解脱。
words.en: The state of being normal; the condition of being usual or typical.

words.ex: He likes all fruits, notably apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use notably to specify an important or typical example of something that you are talking about.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.tr:
adj. 作为结果的；合成的
n. 结果；产物
words.ex: The resultant force moved the box forward.
words.ex_cn: 合力把箱子向前推了。
words.en: A resultant thing or situation is the one that follows or is caused by a particular event or action.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: His guess about the winner was just speculation.
words.ex_cn: 他对获胜者的猜测只是推测。
words.en: The act of forming opinions about what has happened or what might happen without knowing all the facts.

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.ex: The system will validate your password.
words.ex_cn: 系统将验证你的密码。
words.en: To validate something such as a claim or statement means to prove or confirm that it is true or correct.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；在附近；即将到来
words.ex: The solution is at hand.
words.ex_cn: 解决办法就在眼前。
words.en: If something is at hand, it is nearby or about to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…放弃希望或努力；不再继续支持或尝试
words.ex: After failing the test several times, he decided to give up on his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: v. 在多次考试失败后，他决定放弃成为医生的梦想。
words.en: If you give up on something or someone, you stop trying to do or achieve something, or stop believing that they can succeed or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 指导顾问；学校辅导员（负责为学生提供学业、职业和个人发展方面的建议与支持）
words.ex: The guidance counselor helped me choose the right college.
words.ex_cn: 咨询老师帮我选择了合适的大学。
words.en: A guidance counselor is a professional who works in schools or colleges to help students with their academic and personal issues, career planning, and college admissions.

words.tr: phrase. 把…强加于；使承受；打扰；利用
words.ex: The teacher imposed a new rule on the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们施加了一条新规定。
words.en: Force something, such as a rule or belief, onto someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…强加于；利用；打扰；强迫…接受
words.ex: They impose rules upon children to keep them safe.
words.ex_cn: 他们向孩子施加规则以确保他们的安全。
words.en: Force something, such as a rule or belief, onto someone or something (formal alternative to 'on').

words.tr: phrase. 回顾起来；事后看来；回想当初
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回想起来，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.tr: phrase. 放开；松手；释放；放弃
words.ex: You need to let go of the past and move forward.
words.ex_cn: 你需要放下过去，继续前进。
words.en: To release or stop holding something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；弄懂；明白；领会
words.ex: I can't make sense of this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂这个数学题。
words.en: To understand something that is complicated or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B New Words

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: He showed his credentials to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了资历来获得这份工作。
words.en: Credentials are documents that prove your identity or qualifications.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.tr: n. 赌博； v. “gamble”的现在分词；
words.ex: He lost all his money on gambling.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都输在了赌博上。
words.en: Gambling is the act of betting money on the outcome of a game, a contest, or an uncertain event.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: adj. 即将开始的；新任的；
words.ex: The incoming class will start next week.
words.ex_cn: 即将开始的班级将在下周开课。
words.en: An incoming thing or person is arriving or being received.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.tr:
n. 鸽笼式分类架
v. 分类
words.ex: He put the letter in a pigeonhole.
words.ex_cn: 他把信放进了一个小隔间里。
words.en: A pigeonhole is one of the sections in a frame on a wall where letters and messages can be left for someone, or one of the sections in a writing desk where you can keep documents. To pigeonhole someone or something means to decide that they belong to a particular class or category, often without considering all their qualities or characteristics.

words.tr: n. 职业道德；职业特性；专业技巧；职业化
words.ex: He showed great professionalism during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中展现了高度的职业精神。
words.en: Professionalism is the skill, good judgment, and polite behavior that is expected from a person who is trained to do a job well.

words.ex: The city is progressively becoming more crowded.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在逐步变得更加拥挤。
words.en: In a way that happens or develops gradually or in stages; increasingly.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.ex: The note on the fridge is a reminder to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱上的便条是提醒买牛奶的东西。
words.en: A reminder is something that makes you think about or remember someone or something else.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.tr:
n. 卷轴；
v. 卷动；
words.ex: He unrolled the ancient scroll.
words.ex_cn: 他展开了一卷古老的卷轴。
words.en: A scroll is a roll of paper or parchment with writing or pictures on it. As a verb, to scroll means to move displayed text or graphics on a screen in a particular direction in order to view different parts of them.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 对……上瘾；变得沉迷于
words.ex: He becomes addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To develop a strong habit or dependence on something, especially a drug or activity, to the point where it is difficult to stop.

words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: 短语动词. 结束；终止；告一段落
words.ex: The meeting will come to a close at five o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在五点结束。
words.en: To reach the end or conclusion of something.

words.tr: phrase. 突然引起某人注意；一下子吸引住某人
words.ex: The mistake jumps out at me when I read the paper.
words.ex_cn: 当我读这篇论文时，这个错误立刻跳出来引起了我的注意。
words.en: If something jumps out at you, you notice it immediately because it is obvious or very striking.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾食品；无营养食品
words.ex: He eats junk food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃垃圾食品。
words.en: Food that is unhealthy but is quick and easy to eat.

words.tr: phrase. 文科；人文科学（包括语言、哲学、历史、文学、艺术等学科）
words.ex: He majors in liberal arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修文科。
words.en: The liberal arts are academic subjects such as history, literature, and languages, as distinct from professional and technical subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 缩小范围；精简；使变窄
words.ex: He tried to narrow down the list of options.
words.ex_cn: 他试图缩小选项的范围。
words.en: To reduce the number of possibilities or choices.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 更确切地说；倒不如说
words.ex: He is not lazy, or rather, he is efficient in his own way.
words.ex_cn: 他并不懒，或者更准确地说，他有自己的高效方式。
words.en: used to correct or modify what has just been said, or to say it more accurately

words.tr: phrase. 突然进入；顺道拜访；短暂地进去一下
words.ex: Why don't you pop in for a chat sometime?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么不找个时间顺便来聊聊天呢？
words.en: To visit someone briefly and usually without prior notice.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.ex: It took time for the news to sink in.
words.ex_cn: 这则消息花了点时间才让他明白。
words.en: If a fact or idea sinks in, you gradually start to believe it, understand it, or realize the effect it will have on you.

words.tr: phrase. 要是……会怎么样？；如果……怎么办？
words.ex: What if we go to the park tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 如果我们明天去公园呢？
words.en: used to ask about the consequences of something happening or not happening

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A New Words

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.ex: The beggar sat on the street with a cup.
words.ex_cn: 那个乞丐坐在街上，手里拿着一个杯子。
words.en: A beggar is a person who lives by asking people for money or food.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.tr: adj. 迷人的；娇媚的； v. “charm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The little village is charming with its flowers and quiet streets.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄以其花朵和宁静的街道而迷人。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as charming, you mean they are very pleasant and attractive.

words.tr: adj. 唱诗班的；合唱队的；合唱的
words.ex: The children sing in a choral group.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在一个合唱团里唱歌。
words.en: Relating to a choir or chorus; sung or performed by a choir.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.tr:
adj. 被施了魔法的；狂喜的
v. 使着迷；使陶醉；对…施魔法；“enchant”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The girl was enchanted by the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩被魔术表演迷住了。
words.en: If you are enchanted by something, you are delighted or fascinated by it.

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.tr:
n. 炉边；家庭
adj. 炉边的；非正式的
words.ex: They gathered around the fireside to share stories.
words.ex_cn: 他们围坐在炉边分享故事。
words.en: The area near a fireplace or hearth, often considered the center of home life and warmth.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.ex: He garnered food for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他贮藏了过冬的食物。
words.en: To gather or collect something, especially information or support.

words.ex: He lives in a small garret above the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在商店上面的一个小阁楼里。
words.en: A garret is a room on the top floor of a house, immediately under the roof.

words.tr:
n. 猎犬
v. 追逐；纠缠
words.ex: The hound chased the rabbit through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猎犬在森林里追赶兔子。
words.en: A hound is a type of dog used for hunting or chasing. It can also refer to someone who persistently pursues or bothers someone else.

words.ex: The choir sang a beautiful hymn on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 星期天，唱诗班唱了一首优美的赞美诗。
words.en: A hymn is a religious song or poem of praise to God or a god.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.tr: n. 凸窗; 凸出壁外的窗，凸肚窗
words.ex: The oriel window lets in morning light.
words.ex_cn: 凸窗让晨光透进来。
words.en: An oriel is a type of bay window that projects from the main wall of a building but does not reach to the ground.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.tr: n. （声音大而持续或重复的）洪亮的响声; 隆隆声; 洪亮的钟声; 钟乐 vt.& vi. （使）（
words.ex: The bell gave a loud peal.
words.ex_cn: 钟发出了一声响亮的钟声。
words.en: A peal of bells is a series of changes rung on them. To peal means to sound loudly and sonorously.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.ex: The painting is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是无价的。
words.en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money, or that it is very important to you and you could not replace it.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.ex: The schoolmaster was known for his strict discipline.
words.ex_cn: 这位男校长以严格的纪律著称。
words.en: A schoolmaster is a man who teaches in a school, especially a private school.

words.ex: Children play near the seashore.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海岸边玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of the sea or ocean, especially the part that is between the land and the water.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.tr:
adj. 崇高的；壮丽的；极端的；过分的
v. 变高尚；升华
n. 庄严；崇高；顶点
words.ex: The view from the mountain is sublime.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色是壮丽的。
words.en: If you describe something as sublime, you mean that it has a wonderful quality that affects you deeply.

words.tr: v. 遭受；忍受；“suffer”的现在分词； n. 痛苦；苦难；折磨；
words.ex: He is suffering from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正遭受一场重感冒。
words.en: Suffering is the experience of mental or physical pain.

words.tr:
adj. 酸的；辛辣的；尖酸的；刻薄的
n. 甜果馅饼；骚货；妓女
words.ex: The lemon taste is too tart.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬的味道太酸了。
words.en: If something such as fruit is tart, it has a sharp taste. If someone is tart, they are sharp or cutting in their manner or speech.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；“touch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child is touching the soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在触摸柔软的毯子。
words.en: If something is touching, it causes feelings of sadness or sympathy.

words.tr: adj. 非尘世的；怪异的；可怕的；时间过早或不便的
words.ex: The unearthly glow of the northern lights was mesmerizing.
words.ex_cn: 北极光那神秘的光辉令人着迷。
words.en: If you describe something as unearthly, you mean that it seems strange and unnatural, not like anything that exists in the natural world.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He felt weariness after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后感到疲惫。
words.en: A feeling of being extremely tired, either physically or mentally.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.tr: phrase. （猎犬群）全力追逐；热烈地；全力追击；声势浩大地
words.ex: The dogs are in full cry chasing the fox.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗正在全力追捕狐狸。
words.en: If something is in full cry, it is happening or being done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: You can go out on condition that you come home before 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 你可以出去，条件是你必须在晚上10点前回家。
words.en: used to say that one thing will happen only if another thing happens

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: phrase. 宁愿……也不……（用于表达偏好或选择）
words.ex: I would rather walk than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: Used to indicate a preference for one thing over another.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B New Words

words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: She blesses her children every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上为孩子们祝福。
words.en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

words.tr:
n. 屁股；乞丐；游民
v. 讨要；游荡
adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的
words.ex: He fell on his bum.
words.ex_cn: 他摔在了屁股上。
words.en: If someone is bumming around, they are spending time in a relaxed and lazy way, often without a fixed plan or purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.ex: He became a dropout after failing math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试不及格后退学了。
words.en: A dropout is a person who leaves school or college before they have finished their studies, especially because they are not interested in continuing.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: She gave me a grandmotherly hug.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一个慈祥的拥抱。
words.en: Having the qualities or characteristics of a grandmother; kindly, indulgent, or benevolent in a way that is reminiscent of a grandmother.

words.tr: v. 搭便车旅游；沿途搭乘别人车旅行
words.ex: He wants to hitchhike across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他想搭便车横跨全国。
words.en: To travel by getting free rides from passing vehicles.

words.ex: Legends say that some heroes are immortal.
words.ex_cn: 传说有些英雄是不死的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as immortal, you mean that they are so famous or popular that they will be remembered for a very long time.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.ex: He drank a glass of malt.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯麦芽饮料。
words.en: Malt is grain, usually barley, that has been soaked in water, allowed to germinate, and then dried. It is used in brewing and distilling.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: He drank a bottle of soda after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后喝了一瓶苏打。
words.en: A type of drink that contains bubbles of gas and is often sweet.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden stool.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一个木凳上。
words.en: A stool is a seat without a back or arms, typically resting on three or four legs or on a single pedestal.

words.tr:
n. 激浪；拍岸浪花；
v. 冲浪；（互联网上）冲浪；
words.ex: He bought a new surf for the beach trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为海滩之旅买了一块新的激浪。
words.en: To surf means to ride on the crest of a wave towards the shore, typically on a surfboard. It can also mean to browse the internet.

words.tr:
v. （使）旋转
n. 转环；旋轴
words.ex: The chair can swivel easily.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以轻松旋转。
words.en: A swivel is a device that allows something to turn around freely, or to turn something around freely.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 突然产生；要求；成为...负担；偶遇
words.ex: A good idea came upon her while she was walking.
words.ex_cn: 她在散步时突然产生了一个好主意。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance; to suddenly have a thought or feeling.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gave me a ride to school.
words.ex_cn: 他载我去学校。
words.en: To transport someone in a vehicle, especially as a favor or without charge.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gave me a lift to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他载我去车站。
words.en: To take someone somewhere in your car, especially when they need help getting there.

words.w: make a commitment to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 承诺去做某事；保证做某事
words.uk: meɪk ə kəˈmɪtmənt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə kəˈmɪtmənt tə du ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He made a commitment to study every day.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺每天学习。
words.en: To promise or decide to do something.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: My grandfather passed away last year.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父去年去世了。
words.en: If someone passes away, they die.

words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细思考；反省；回顾；深思
words.ex: He reflects upon his mistakes every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上反思自己的错误。
words.en: To think deeply or carefully about something.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A New Words

words.tr:
adj. 疏远的；冷淡的
adv. 远离地
words.ex: He stayed aloof during the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上保持冷淡。
words.en: Someone who is aloof is not very friendly and does not like to spend time with other people.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr: v. 计算；“calculate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 计算的；
words.ex: He calculated the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算了总费用。
words.en: If something is calculated to have a particular effect, it is deliberately done in order to have that effect.

words.ex: In some countries, caste determines a person's job and social status.
words.ex_cn: 在一些国家，社会等级决定一个人的职业和社会地位。
words.en: A caste is one of the traditional social classes into which people are divided in a Hindu society.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: He was born a commoner but rose to become a respected leader.
words.ex_cn: 他出身平民，但最终成为受人尊敬的领袖。
words.en: A commoner is someone who is not of noble rank.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.tr: adv. 使人窘迫地；令人仓皇失措地
words.ex: He smiled disconcertingly, even when he was upset.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很不安，他还是令人不安地微笑着。
words.en: In a manner that causes one to feel unsettled or confused.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人憎恶的；令人不悦的
words.ex: The taste of medicine is distasteful.
words.ex_cn: 药的味道很难吃。
words.en: If something is distasteful to you, you think it is unpleasant, disgusting, or immoral.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: Everyone deserves equality in education.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应享有教育平等。
words.en: Equality is the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.tr: adj. 与好的品味相悖的；不合礼节的；下流的；有伤风化的
words.ex: He wore an indecent shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件不雅的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as indecent, you mean that it is shocking or offensive, usually because it relates to sex or nakedness.

words.ex: He is an individualistic person who likes to work alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢独来独往的个人主义的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as individualistic, you mean that they like to think and do things in their own way, rather than imitating other people.

words.ex: They share intimacy through quiet talks at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过夜晚的安静交谈建立亲密感。
words.en: A close, familiar, and usually affectionate or loving personal relationship with another person or group.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: He does not want to intrude on their conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他不想插话他们的谈话。
words.en: To intrude means to enter somewhere or become involved in a situation where you are not wanted or are not supposed to be.

words.ex: The intrusion of strangers made her feel unsafe.
words.ex_cn: 陌生人的闯入让她感到不安全。
words.en: An intrusion is an unwanted event or person in a situation where they are not welcome or do not belong.

words.ex: His involvement in the project helped it succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他参与这个项目帮助它取得了成功。
words.en: The act of taking part in something or the state of being connected with something.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.ex: The nobleman lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A nobleman is a man who belongs to the noble class in a society, especially in the past.

words.ex: The obscene behavior shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这种可憎的行为让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as obscene, you mean it offends you because it relates to sex or violence in a way that you think is unpleasant and shocking.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.tr: n. 厌恶；嫌弃；排斥；斥力
words.ex: The sight filled her with repulsion.
words.ex_cn: 那景象让她感到厌恶。
words.en: A feeling of intense distaste or disgust.

words.tr:
adj. 克制的；有节制的；拘束的；朴素的
v. 抑制；抑止；“restrain”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was restrained when he heard the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个坏消息时，他很克制。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior or remarks as restrained, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a situation where you would expect them to be angry or upset.

words.ex: The separateness of the two teams caused communication problems.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队的分离导致了沟通问题。
words.en: The state or quality of being separate or distinct.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.tr: v. 象征；代表；用符号表示
words.ex: The dove symbolizes peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子象征和平。
words.en: If one thing symbolizes another, it is used or regarded as a symbol of it.

words.tr: v. 威胁；“threaten”的现在分词； adj. 威胁的；
words.ex: He was threatening the neighbor with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用棍子威胁邻居。
words.en: If someone's behavior or actions are threatening, they make you feel that they might harm you.

words.ex: The tribal people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 部落的人住在森林里。
words.en: Tribal relates to a tribe or tribes.

words.tr: adv. 意外地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: He arrived unexpectedly at my house.
words.ex_cn: 他意外地来到我家。
words.en: In a way that was not expected; surprisingly.

words.tr: n. 不能触摸；远不可及；（印）贱民身份
words.ex: He fought against untouchability in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他为反对自己村庄里的不可接触制度而斗争。
words.en: The state of being untouchable, especially in the context of the caste system in India, where certain groups of people are considered to be outside the caste system and are subjected to social ostracism and discrimination.

words.tr: n. 西方人；西欧人；（美国的）西部人
words.ex: The westerner tried dumplings for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这位西方人第一次尝试了饺子。
words.en: A person from the western part of a country or the Western world.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 使聚集在一起；使团结；拉拢
words.ex: The family will draw together during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 家人将在假期团聚。
words.en: To bring people or things closer to each other, either physically or in terms of relationships.

words.ex: I might drop in at your house this evening.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚可能会顺便去你家。
words.en: To visit someone informally and often without notice.

words.tr: phrase. 达成妥协；实现和解
words.ex: They tried to effect a compromise to end the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图达成一项妥协来结束这场争吵。
words.en: Achieve a settlement or agreement between conflicting parties.

words.tr: phrase. 童话故事；幻想；虚构的事
words.ex: The little girl loves to hear a fairy tale before bed.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩喜欢在睡觉前听童话故事。
words.en: A fairy tale is a type of short story that typically features folkloric fantasy characters, such as dwarves, elves, fairies, giants, gnomes, goblins, mermaids, trolls, or witches, and usually magic or enchantments.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抵挡；避开；击退（攻击、批评、威胁等）
words.ex: He used a stick to fend off the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子赶走了那只狗。
words.en: To fend off means to defend oneself against something or someone, or to keep them away.

words.ex: He talks to his dog in private.
words.ex_cn: 他私下跟他的狗说话。
words.en: If you do something in private, you do it without other people being present, often because it is something that you want to keep secret.

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的陪伴下；与…在一起
words.ex: She enjoyed her time in the company of friends.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢和朋友在一起的时光。
words.en: If you are in the company of someone, you are with them.

words.tr: phrase. 保持距离；疏远；不亲近
words.ex: He keeps his distance from the dog because he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 他远离那只狗，因为他害怕。
words.en: To maintain a physical or emotional distance from someone or something, often to avoid getting too involved or to stay safe.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.ex: The price of fruit may vary with the season.
words.ex_cn: 水果的价格可能随季节而变化。
words.en: If something varies with something else, it changes depending on that other thing.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B New Words

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: The new movie was a blockbuster and sold out every show.
words.ex_cn: 这部新电影大受欢迎，场场爆满。
words.en: A blockbuster is a film or book that is very popular and successful, especially one that has made a lot of money.

words.ex: I went to the park with my buddy.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的同伴去了公园。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.tr: n. 结构；布局；配置；外形
words.ex: The configuration of the computer is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑的配置非常简单。
words.en: The arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: n. 弹跳；打漂; vi. 轻点水面；在地面上弹跳; vt. 使点水；使弹跳; adj. 衣冠楚楚的...
words.ex: He dap his hand on the table to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他拍打桌子以引起注意。
words.en: To strike gently with a light blow or tap; a light blow or tap.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 州长昨天签署了这项新法律。
words.en: A governor is a person who is responsible for the political administration of a region, such as a state or a colony.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: The inauguration of the new bridge was celebrated with a parade.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的落成典礼以一场游行来庆祝。
words.en: The act of starting a new operation or practice; the formal admission of someone to office.

words.ex: The infantry marched through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 步兵穿过森林行进。
words.en: Infantry refers to soldiers who fight on foot, especially in contrast to cavalry or artillery.

words.tr: adj. 相互连接的；互相联系的； v. “interconnect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The cities are interconnected by highways.
words.ex_cn: 这些城市通过高速公路相互连接。
words.en: If things are interconnected, they are connected to each other in some way.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr: n. 长角牛，音乐探测器
words.ex: The longhorn has big horns.
words.ex_cn: 长角牛有大角。
words.en: A longhorn is a breed of cattle with long horns, originally from the United States.

words.ex: The school mascot is a happy tiger.
words.ex_cn: 学校的吉祥物是一只快乐的老虎。
words.en: A mascot is a person, animal, or object that is adopted by a group as a symbolic figure to bring them good luck.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: His nickname is 'Speedy' because he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的绰号是‘飞毛腿’，因为他跑得快。
words.en: A nickname is an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.tr: adj. 带淡红色的 n. 小指(=pinkie)
words.ex: She painted her pinky nail red.
words.ex_cn: 她把小指的指甲涂成了红色。
words.en: The smallest finger on the hand, or something that is pink in color.

words.ex: The elf has pointy-eared features.
words.ex_cn: 这个精灵有尖耳朵的特征。
words.en: Having ears that are pointed or sharp in shape.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.tr:
n. （军队的）团；大群；大量
v. 把...编组；严格管制
words.ex: He joined the army and was in a regiment.
words.ex_cn: 他参军了，被编入一个团。
words.en: A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: He wrote a warm salutation at the start of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信的开头写了一个热情的问候语。
words.en: A salutation is a greeting or an expression of goodwill.

words.tr:
n. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
v. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
words.ex: The soldier gave a salute to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向军官敬礼。
words.en: If you salute someone, you greet them or show your respect with a formal sign. Soldiers usually salute officers by raising their right hand so that their fingers touch their forehead.

words.ex: He loves reading sci-fi about space travel.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于太空旅行的科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction, often called sci-fi, is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.ex: He used superglue to fix the broken cup.
words.ex_cn: 他用瞬干胶修理了破掉的杯子。
words.en: A very strong adhesive that bonds quickly and is used for sticking materials together.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.tr:
v. （使）倾斜；（使）偏向
n. 倾斜；企图
words.ex: The boy tilt the cup and spill the water.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把杯子倾斜，水洒了出来。
words.en: If you tilt an object or if it tilts, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 艰苦跋涉；
v. 长途跋涉；
words.ex: The trek across the mountains took five days.
words.ex_cn: 穿越群山的艰苦跋涉花了五天时间。
words.en: A trek is a long and often difficult journey, especially one made on foot.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.ex: He is known for his kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: If someone or something is known for a particular quality or feature, they are famous or recognized because of it.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a previous place, time, or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠闲地待着
words.ex: He tells his friend to hang loose before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前告诉朋友放松点。
words.en: To remain calm and relaxed, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: He pointed at the map with his index finger.
words.ex_cn: 他用食指指着地图。
words.en: The finger next to the thumb; the forefinger.

words.ex: He speaks his native tongue at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家说他的母语。
words.en: The language that a person has spoken from earliest childhood.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A New Words

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: n. 鉴赏家（或鉴定家、行家）身份，鉴赏（或鉴定）力
words.ex: He has great connoisseurship in fine wine.
words.ex_cn: 他对优质葡萄酒有很高的鉴赏力。
words.en: The ability to judge the quality and skill in art, music, food, etc.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: He tries not to demean his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他尽量不贬低他的同学。
words.en: To demean someone or something means to cause them to lose their dignity or respect.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: adj. 破坏性的；引起混乱的；
words.ex: The new technology caused disruptive changes in the market.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术给市场带来了破坏性的变化。
words.en: Causing or tending to cause disruption.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.ex: He extols the beauty of nature every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天赞美大自然的美。
words.en: If you extol something or someone, you praise them enthusiastically.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: Completing the project gave him a sense of fulfilment.
words.ex_cn: 完成这个项目给了他一种满足感。
words.en: Fulfilment refers to the achievement of something desired, promised, or predicted, or the satisfaction or happiness derived from this.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: n. 仅一部分为事实的报导，半真半假的陈词
words.ex: He told a half-truth to avoid trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他为了避免麻烦，说了半真半假的话。
words.en: A half-truth is a statement that conveys only part of the truth, especially one that is intended to deceive or mislead.

words.ex: He is a high-performing student in math.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名数学成绩优异的学生。
words.en: A high-performing person, team, or organization is one that consistently achieves excellent results.

words.ex: The company wants to innovate its production process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想改革它的生产流程。
words.en: To innovate means to introduce changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.tr: v. 对…予以惩罚；使处于不利地位
words.ex: The teacher will penalize students who cheat.
words.ex_cn: 老师会惩罚作弊的学生。
words.en: To penalize someone means to punish them or make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.tr: adj. 规定的；指定的；约定俗成的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prescriptive rule for writing essays.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个关于写论文的规定性规则。
words.en: If something is prescriptive, it involves making rules or giving instructions about what should be done.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: The doctor checked his pulse with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手指检查了他的脉搏。
words.en: A pulse is the regular beating of the heart, especially when it is felt at the wrist or neck. It can also refer to a single vibration or short burst of sound, electric current, light, etc.

words.tr: v. 反胃；回吐；依样复述
words.ex: He felt sick and began to regurgitate after eating the spoiled food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了变质的食物后感到恶心，开始反胃。
words.en: To bring up and expel (food) from the stomach to the mouth, as in some birds feeding their young; to repeat (information) without understanding or thought.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: n. 死记硬背；机械的做法；生搬硬套
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote is the process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: She loves painting for self-expression.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢通过绘画来表达自我。
words.en: Self-expression is the expression of one's feelings, thoughts, or ideas, especially through writing, art, music, or dance.

words.tr: n. （越野）障碍赛；越野赛跑；越野障碍赛马
words.ex: He runs the steeplechase every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都参加障碍赛跑。
words.en: A steeplechase is a long race in which horses or runners have to jump over fences, hedges, and other obstacles.

words.ex: The smoke began to stifle her breathing.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾开始让她窒息。
words.en: To stifle something means to prevent it from happening, continuing, or developing.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He proved the theorem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上证明了这个定理。
words.en: A theorem is a statement that has been proven on the basis of previously established statements, such as other theorems, and generally accepted statements, such as axioms.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.tr: adj. 不受约束的；无拘无束的
words.ex: He sang uninhibited at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上毫无拘束地唱歌。
